body: PROGRESS BAR COLOR RULES. Rule 1: color encodes zone not identity. 90+ green #3FB950, 70+ blue #3479D0 (Pistons-adjacent, lighter for contrast), 50+ amber #E8A317, below 50 red #FF3A55, 0 attempts rgba(255,255,255,0.15). Rule 2: always show track background rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Rule 3: min visible fill 4px if pct>0. Rule 4: animate fill width 400ms ease-out on update. Rule 5: no text inside bar. Rule 6: contrast verified before use. I apply before writing any spec with score ranges.
